text:
auditor_kevin: Hey team — auditor request: can you provide an extract that proves which service principals used CMK arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01 during 2025-10-01..2025-11-15, and map each principal to the RBAC change ticket that authorized access? CSV or JSON is fine. We also need the rotation record and any vuln-triage notes that led to rotation. Minimal PII preferred.

maria (eng-security): Ack. We can provide CloudTrail KMS events (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), IAM binding diffs, and the rotation manifest. Quick q: do you need object-level S3 access logs tied to those keys or just KMS API events? Also confirm timeframe.

auditor_kevin: KMS API events are primary. If you can include S3 object-level linking it helps but not required. Timeframe confirmed. Prefer CSV with columns: eventTime, eventName, keyId, principalArn, sourceIPAddress, requestID, ticketID

sam (platform-security): For export we can run an Athena query over CloudTrail logs. Example SQL:

```
SELECT eventTime, eventName, requestParameters.keyId as keyId,
       userIdentity.arn as principalArn, sourceIPAddress, eventId as requestID
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE (eventName IN ("Encrypt","Decrypt","GenerateDataKey","ReEncrypt"))
  AND json_extract_scalar(requestParameters,'$.keyId') = 'arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01'
  AND eventTime BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-11-15';
```

This returns rows we can join to an RBAC mapping table.

josh (infra): Note: rotation happened 2025-10-22 per JIRA PLAT-987. Triage notes and vuln link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-987 and internal doc https://confluence.redwood.com/display/Sec/KMS+rotation+2025-10-22.

maria (eng-security): sample CSV header we'll produce:
```
eventTime,eventName,keyId,principalArn,sourceIPAddress,requestID,ticketID,notes
```
sample row: `2025-10-12T14:22:05Z,Decrypt,arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01,arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ingest,34.82.12.8,evt-0a1b2c3d,PLAT-780,"used by ingest job to decrypt model shards"`

maria (eng-security): We'll attach the rotation manifest (signed by security lead) and the CloudTrail export. For rotation cryptographic attestation: AWS KMS rotation events plus CloudHSM cluster audit logs are available. Need to know if the auditor requires raw HSM logs or an extracted statement (they usually accept a signed manifest).

auditor_kevin: We will accept a signed manifest if it includes key material change timestamp, keyId, and the HSM cluster serials. Can you also include the GetPublicKey/DescribeKey events?

sam (platform-security): We can include DescribeKey/GetPublicKey. Quick CLI commands to produce the initial CloudTrail slices:

```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2025-11-15T23:59:59Z --max-results 500
```

Or run Athena query above for full export. Here is a redacted CloudTrail event snippet we will include in the evidence bundle:

```
{ "eventTime":"2025-10-12T14:22:05Z",
  "eventName":"Decrypt",
  "requestParameters":{ "keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01" },
  "userIdentity":{ "arn":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-ingest","type":"AssumedRole","principalId":"ARO..." },
  "sourceIPAddress":"34.82.12.8",
  "eventID":"evt-0a1b2c3d"
}
```

maria (eng-security): For RBAC mapping: we will correlate the principalArn to k8s serviceaccount via our identity sync table (role -> k8s subject). Example RBAC audit log entry:

```
2025-10-10T09:12:03Z audit: verb=bind user="system:admin" objectRef=ClusterRoleBinding/name="ingest-binder" subject="ServiceAccount:ingest:default" change=ADD
```
We will map that back to ticket PLAT-721 which requested the binding.

auditor_kevin: One more ask — can you include a short vulnerability triage summary that triggered the rotation? High level is fine. We don't need raw vuln scanner output.

maria (eng-security): Will include a 1-page triage: vulnerability ID, risk rating, affected workload, mitigation (rotation), post-rotation verification steps. We'll redact internal IPs.

deploy-bot: upload started -> s3://redwood-compliance-evidence/230-2312345678/key-usage-export-2025-10-01_2025-11-15.csv (presigned link expires in 14 days).

auditor_kevin: thanks — can you also drop the SIEM correlation query (Splunk/BigQuery) you used so we can reproduce?

sam (platform-security): Splunk example: `index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt keyId=\"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01\" | table _time, userIdentity.arn, src, eventId`

maria (eng-security): ETA for packaged evidence (CSV + rotation manifest + RBAC mapping + triage page + raw CloudTrail slice): EOD today. Will post final S3 link and upload a signed manifest PDF. Anything else?

auditor_kevin: that's perfect, thanks :thumbsup:
